rows.en: Hmm… Reckon I'm workin' too hard?

Never mind that… What on earth is going on, with MAT and EAGLE both?

Aki's birthday party that was planned got called off too.
The, uh… whatchamacallit… I hear the analysis data on those Gorenger Suit things got stolen.

No need to worry… They're developin' new suits and a New Ball!

Before I use new moves, I gotta build up my strength… Master, seconds!

Honestly, you…

But… today you're paying up! That tab you've been running up!
No problem! [HERO2]'ll pay the tab for me!
Wha!? What are you saying, Dai!? Why me?

Well, can't be helped…

The only other folks here are Ichijouji and [HERO4]… Can't have a lady pay, and Ichijouji's monthly pay is 3,000 yen!

That leaves nobody but [HERO2]! Whaddaya say? Wahahaha!!
What's with the "wahahaha"!
What a pickle… So, what'll you do, [HERO2]?
"Sigh, oh well…" / "You've gotta be kidding!"
I'm freeloading off Oyassan and causing him trouble all the time anyway… But just this once, Dai, got it?
Sorry, Oyassan, but… nope… Pay it yourself, Dai!
Heh heh heh… Master, seconds!!
Boo hoo hoo…
But… I'm worried about Go, aren't you? Do you think he's all right?
Huh? What happened to Go?

What are you talking about, Dai! Ultraman lost, you know. I bet Go is… ah

No, never mind!
Huh? Go and Ultraman??? Now that's a tough riddle!
Huh? Mr. Oiwa, you've got a cold? Don't give it to me!

Never mind that… What on earth is going on, with MAT and EAGLE both?

Aki's birthday party that was planned got called off too.
Wha!? That's not fair, Mr. Oiwa!? Why me?

Well, can't be helped…

The only other folks here are Ichijouji and [HERO4]… Can't have a lady pay, and Ichijouji's monthly pay is 3,000 yen!

That leaves nobody but [HERO2]! Whaddaya say? Wahahaha!!
Even so… why does it have to be me?
What a pickle… So, what'll you do, [HERO2]?
"Sigh… I can't win against you, Mr. Oiwa…" / "Hold on a minute here"
I'm freeloading off Mr. Tachibana and causing him trouble all the time anyway… But just this once, Mr. Oiwa!
Sorry, Mr. Tachibana, but… no… Please pay it yourself, Mr. Oiwa!
But… what happened to Go? Is he okay? I'm worried, aren't you?

What are you talking about, Mr. Oiwa! Ultraman lost, you know. I bet Go is… ah

No, it's nothing…

(…………

Ultraman lost…

Even so… defending itself with a barrier… What a terrifying monster…)
Gooo!

Hey… You came to see me?

But I'm sorry I ruined your birthday party…

No, it's all right…

But I'm glad… You look better than I expected.
Nah… A wound like this won't keep me down.
I'm glad. It wasn't anything serious…
Oka… Any movement from the kaiju since then?
Nothing unusual so far…
It'll come out again for sure!
But in the results of the follow-up investigation… ah…
It's about work… Could you excuse us for a bit?

…………

We'll be going! The two of us…
Sorry, but please do…
Jiro, let's go home, okay?
I'm very sorry…
Not at all…
Go… You've fallen for this lady, haven't you?
What are you saying, you little rascal!
I'll bet that's it.
Jiro, you mustn't say things like that!

But…

We were supposed to be having sis's birthday party, and we paid the train fare and came all this way!

Sis even bought new shoes!
It's all right… Well, take care of yourself, okay?
Yeah…
Tch…
Something about the kaiju?

The follow-up investigation… revealed that it breathes a radioactive ray.

The kaiju's name is Kingsaurus III! The TDF database also records that it has attacked power plants twice in the past.
Radiation? In that case… it must be the No. 1 Nuclear Power Plant after all?

The Captain is worried about that too.

Oh, and also, Kishida sent this…

It's a new weapon, the Space Laser Gun! He really wants you to try it out, Go…
(All right… The next time it comes out, no matter what…)
Shinmei, dive bombing, here we go!
Roger! Diving!!
Target 3, fire Sky Lock!

Target 3, firing Sky Lock!

Fire!! Switch on!!
Open the ailerons, turn around!
Yes, sir!
It's no good! They won't open!!
Shinmei!!
Waaaagh!!
Who tries to open the ailerons while they're still locked!! Once more, here we go.
Yes, sir! Please!
All right, now it's dogfighting! Give it a try!
We did it!
All riiight! That's the way, Shinmei!!
Not yet… Once more, here we go!
What is it, [HERO2]? Out here… What did you want to talk about?
[HERO4]… Don't ask any questions, just be my partner!
Wha… Whaaat!?
Actually, I've come up with a new technique too. And it's a "combination attack"! [HERO4], be my partner for some special training!

Special training??? Oh, so that's what you meant… You really startled me, geez!

…So, what kind of new combination attack is it?

uncertain: U08744/U08746: [HERO2]どん (Daita's dialect honorific) rendered as bare [HERO2]; 大ちゃん "Dai"; 一条寺さん "Ichijouji".
U08749/U08764: player choice options, joined with " / ".
U08769: 『』 thought in ( ); the kaiju referred to as "it".
U08780: 私たち — Aki and Jiro.
U08815-U08818: 付き合ってくれ pun (date / keep me company) rendered with "be my partner" to keep the misunderstanding.
